Filing a Change of Address

Use this procedure to update the mailing address held on file by the Bureau. Allow time for the update to be processed before relying on it.

  1. Sign in to the customer portal with your account number.
  2. Open the Profile page and select Edit Address.
  3. Enter the new address and upload one proof of residence document.
  4. Submit the form and keep the confirmation number.

The Bureau confirms the change by letter within 7 business days. If no letter arrives, contact the help desk quoting your confirmation number.
